_metadata.description: Exposure manifest (SSOT): SQLite-backed record of what is publicly exposed at which subdomain/port, tier, lease, and enabled state. Every other domain reconciles against this manifest.

requirements.title: Persist routes in a SQLite-backed exposure manifest
requirements.description: A route record persists subdomain, scenario, domain (a field, default itsagitime.com), local UI port, tier (core|leased), lease_id (nullable), enabled flag, and health_path in SQLite, and survives process restart.

requirements.title: Reject a route whose subdomain is not a valid DNS label
requirements.description: Route creation validates the subdomain against DNS label rules (lowercase alphanumeric and hyphens, no leading/trailing hyphen, <=63 chars) and rejects invalid labels with a validation error.

requirements.title: Enforce one route per subdomain
requirements.description: Attempting to create a second route for an already-used subdomain is rejected (unique constraint), preventing ambiguous ingress targets.

requirements.title: Derive public_url from subdomain and domain
requirements.description: A route exposes a computed public_url of https://<subdomain>.<domain> derived from its fields rather than a stored constant, so changing the domain field changes the URL.
